capabilities: apply formatting to selections that span paragraph breaks
toggle formatting on for text typed next when nothing is selected
define custom formatting styles with left and right markers
skip headings inside a large selection
format the word under the cursor when the selection is empty
extras: The README warns that the plugin has had limited testing, is not designed to work with codeblocks, and may misbehave when selections include code blocks embedded in list items or blockquotes.
problem: Obsidian's built-in formatting commands fail or behave poorly when the selected text contains paragraph breaks in the middle.

relations.evidence: lynchjames, whose Note Refactor Plugin formed the base for this plugin
to THeK3nger for the Obsidian Plugin Template

summary: Editing plugin that applies Markdown formatting to a selection spanning paragraph breaks, with custom formatting styles and commands.
